# LaTeX Build Instructions

## Quick Build Commands
- **Full Build**: `Ctrl+Alt+B` (or click the Play button)
- **Quick Build**: Use the "Build LaTeX (Fast)" task
- **Continuous Watch**: Use "general: continuous compilation" recipe

## Live Preview Features
- The extension provides real-time PDF preview
- Click the Play button (▶) in the LaTeX Workshop status bar
- Use `Ctrl+Alt+L` to toggle live preview
- Click on error markers in the PDF to jump to source code

## Best Practices
- Use the fast build for text editing
- Use full build for citation/reference changes  
- Let the extension handle automatic rebuilding
- Use the watch mode for continuous compilation
